You write the plan a back-office run will be checked against. Reply with one JSON object only, in the
schema given. Rules:
1. 1 to 7 milestones (aim for 3 to 7). Each is a TARGET STATE of a record the run creates or changes, or must leave
   unchanged, in words; never a click, a tool call, or finding or reading something. Each names its sop_step;
   every record the run will write is read by some milestone. Use only the args and row_fields of the tool list.
2. Each milestone is checked by predicates: one API read tool call (read, args) whose rows are picked by `where`
   and must show `expect` (exact values) or `contains`; `count` is how many rows match (0 = must not exist).
3. Find rows by business keys (numbers, names, statuses), never a database id: {"ref": "M1"} is the id of the row
   that milestone M1's first predicate found (that predicate must find exactly one row).
4. Every value comes from the facts, the goal, the procedure or the tool list. Never invent one.
5. The procedure's "leave everything else unchanged" step becomes a count 0 predicate.
6. awaits_business_approval: true on a milestone whose record will wait for a business approval.
7. Every procedure step that writes (its Source names a POST) is the sop_step of a milestone. Only a step whose
   title says "when ..." may instead be a key of not_applicable, with the reason it does not apply here: decide
   from its Target and the facts (amounts are in paise: Rs 50,000 is 5,000,000 paise) whether its condition
   holds; when it does not, list it in not_applicable or check its "otherwise" state.
8. judge: at most 3 short criteria that no exact predicate can check (tone; whether a text says something in
   words), on a milestone whose predicates find the record. Exact checks stay predicates.

{"goal": {"request": "Onboard Priya Nair, she joins Monday.", "sop_id": "onboard-employee", "fields": [{"name": "employee_name", "value": "Priya Nair", "source": "request"}, {"name": "start_date", "value": "Monday", "source": "request"}], "success": ["Priya Nair onboarded as new employee starting Monday."]}, "facts": {"employee_name": "Priya Nair", "employee_email": "priya.nair@acme.example", "employee_role": "Software Engineer", "employee_department": "Engineering", "manager_name": "Sunita Deshpande", "manager_id": 2, "start_date": "2026-10-12"}, "sop_id": "onboard-employee", "read_tools": [{"read": "find_vendors", "about": "List vendors in the vendor master (id, name, GSTIN, status, contact email); q filters by name.", "args": {"q": "any"}, "row_fields": ["id", "status"]}, {"read": "get_vendor", "about": "Read one vendor from the vendor master.", "args": {"vendor_id": "integer"}, "row_fields": ["id", "status"]}, {"read": "list_invoices", "about": "List invoices, newest first, optionally for one vendor id and one status.", "args": {"vendor": "any", "status": "any"}, "row_fields": ["amount_paise", "due_date", "id", "invoice_date", "invoice_id", "invoice_no", "po_number", "status", "tax_paise", "vendor_id"]}, {"read": "get_invoice", "about": "Read one invoice with its approvals and payment requests.", "args": {"invoice_id": "integer"}, "row_fields": ["amount_paise", "due_date", "id", "invoice_date", "invoice_id", "invoice_no", "po_number", "status", "tax_paise", "vendor_id"]}, {"read": "list_approvals", "about": "List business approval requests, newest first, optionally by status.", "args": {"status": "any"}, "row_fields": ["approval_id", "entity_id", "entity_type", "id", "status"]}, {"read": "get_approval", "about": "Read one business approval request.", "args": {"approval_id": "integer"}, "row_fields": ["approval_id", "entity_id", "entity_type", "id", "status"]}, {"read": "list_payments", "about": "List payment requests, optionally for one invoice id and one status.", "args": {"invoice": "any", "status": "any"}, "row_fields": ["id", "invoice_id", "payment_id", "scheduled_date", "status"]}, {"read": "get_payment", "about": "Read one payment request with its approvals.", "args": {"payment_id": "integer"}, "row_fields": ["id", "invoice_id", "payment_id", "scheduled_date", "status"]}, {"read": "find_employees", "about": "List employees; q filters by part of the name.", "args": {"q": "any"}, "row_fields": ["department", "email", "id", "manager_id", "name", "role", "start_date", "status", "version"]}, {"read": "get_employee", "about": "Read one employee record.", "args": {"employee_id": "integer"}, "row_fields": ["department", "email", "employee_id", "id", "manager_id", "name", "role", "start_date", "status"]}, {"read": "list_it_tickets", "about": "List IT tickets, newest first, optionally for one employee id.", "args": {"employee": "any"}, "row_fields": ["employee_id", "id", "status", "ticket_id", "type"]}, {"read": "get_it_ticket", "about": "Read one IT ticket.", "args": {"ticket_id": "integer"}, "row_fields": ["employee_id", "id", "status", "ticket_id", "type"]}, {"read": "list_audit", "about": "Read Acme's audit log after an audit id (page with next_since while has_more is true).", "args": {"since": "any", "limit": "any"}, "row_fields": ["id", "status"]}, {"read": "list_mail", "about": "List mail summaries (no bodies), newest first; folder inbox (default) or outbox.", "args": {"folder": "any"}, "row_fields": ["attachments", "created_by", "external", "folder", "from_addr", "id", "subject", "to_addr", "ts"]}, {"read": "read_mail", "about": "Read one mail message with its body and attachment names.", "args": {"mail_id": "integer"}, "row_fields": ["attachments", "body", "created_by", "external", "folder", "from_addr", "id", "subject", "to_addr", "ts"]}, {"read": "list_files", "about": "List the PDF files Acme holds (invoices and other documents).", "args": {}, "row_fields": ["id", "status"]}, {"read": "download_file", "about": "Download one of Acme's PDF files into this run's scratch folder.", "args": {"name": "string"}, "row_fields": ["id", "status"]}, {"read": "download_attachment", "about": "Download a mail attachment into this run's scratch folder.", "args": {"mail_id": "integer", "name": "string"}, "row_fields": ["id", "status"]}], "schema": {"$defs": {"Milestone": {"additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"id": {"pattern": "^M[1-9]$", "title": "Id", "type": "string"}, "target": {"maxLength": 200, "minLength": 1, "title": "Target", "type": "string"}, "sop_step": {"anyOf": [{"type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null, "title": "Sop Step"}, "after": {"items": {"type": "string"}, "title": "After", "type": "array"}, "predicates": {"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/Predicate"}, "title": "Predicates", "type": "array"}, "unverifiable_reason": {"anyOf": [{"type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null, "title": "Unverifiable Reason"}, "critical": {"default": true, "title": "Critical", "type": "boolean"}, "awaits_business_approval": {"default": false, "title": "Awaits Business Approval", "type": "boolean"}, "judge": {"items": {"maxLength": 200, "type": "string"}, "maxItems": 3, "title": "Judge", "type": "array"}}, "required": ["id", "target"], "title": "Milestone", "type": "object"}, "Predicate": {"additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"read": {"pattern": "^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,40}$", "title": "Read", "type": "string"}, "args": {"additionalProperties": {"anyOf": [{"type": "string"}, {"type": "integer"}, {"type": "boolean"}, {"$ref": "#/$defs/Ref"}, {"type": "null"}]}, "title": "Args", "type": "object"}, "where": {"additionalProperties": {"anyOf": [{"type": "string"}, {"type": "integer"}, {"type": "boolean"}, {"$ref": "#/$defs/Ref"}, {"type": "null"}]}, "title": "Where", "type": "object"}, "expect": {"additionalProperties": {"anyOf": [{"type": "string"}, {"type": "integer"}, {"type": "boolean"}, {"type": "null"}]}, "title": "Expect", "type": "object"}, "contains": {"additionalProperties": {"items": {"type": "string"}, "type": "array"}, "title": "Contains", "type": "object"}, "count": {"default": 1, "minimum": 0, "title": "Count", "type": "integer"}}, "required": ["read"], "title": "Predicate", "type": "object"}, "Ref": {"additionalProperties": false, "description": "The id of the row found by the FIRST predicate of milestone `ref` (that predicate must find exactly one).", "properties": {"ref": {"pattern": "^M[1-9]$", "title": "Ref", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["ref"], "title": "Ref", "type": "object"}}, "additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"sop_id": {"anyOf": [{"pattern": "^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,40}$", "type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null, "title": "Sop Id"}, "milestones": {"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/Milestone"}, "maxItems": 7, "title": "Milestones", "type": "array"}, "not_applicable": {"additionalProperties": {"type": "string"}, "title": "Not Applicable", "type": "object"}}, "title": "Plan", "type": "object"}}

Procedure:
---
id: onboard-employee
title: Onboard a new employee
triggers: [onboard, onboarding, joins, new hire, new employee]
---
Turns a short onboarding request into an employee record, IT tickets and a welcome email.

### OE-1 Find the person's offer email and avoid duplicates
- Target: one HR offer email for the named person is chosen, and no active employee record exists for them.
- Source: `GET /api/mail` and `GET /api/mail/{mail_id}` for the offer email; `GET /api/employees` to look for an existing record.
- Ask when: no offer email exists, two offer emails or two similarly named people could match, or the person already exists.

### OE-2 Collect the details and the start date
- Target: email, role, department and manager come from the HR offer email; the start date comes from the request, with
  a relative date such as "Monday" resolved against the date the runtime supplies. The manager is an active employee.
- Source: the offer email body; the request text; `GET /api/employees` to resolve the manager.
- Ask when: any of the five values is missing, the manager matches more than one employee, or the start date is not given.

### OE-3 Create the employee record
- Target: one employee record exists with those details, in onboarding status, with an internal email address.
- Source: the collected details; `POST /api/employees` or the page `/employees/new`.
- Ask when: Acme rejects a field (for example an email outside the internal domain).

### OE-4 Raise the IT tickets
- Target: exactly one laptop ticket and one accounts ticket exist for the employee.
- Source: the employee record read back; `POST /api/it-tickets` or the page `/it-tickets/new`.
- Ask when: a ticket of that type already exists for the employee.

### OE-5 Send the welcome email
- Target: one email to the employee's internal address states the start date and who the manager is. It is internal,
  so no action approval is needed; an email to any external domain would need one (ORG-005).
- Source: the employee record; `POST /api/mail/send` or the page `/mail/compose`; read back from the outbox with `GET /api/mail` (folder outbox).
- Ask when: the employee's address is not in the internal domain.
